visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) [People: Face/Hands] A young man wearing a black Tamiya shirt and a Toy Story baseball cap sits cross-legged on a grey bench, reading a manga book. A woman in a blue cropped top and grey skirt kneels on the floor, tugging his pant legs. [Objects] The book is held with both hands; green pants have stripes. [Setting] An indoor living room with a toy shelf and a large box. (2) [People] The woman releases his legs and reaches back with both hands to adjust her hair into a ponytail. The man lowers the book and looks down at her. [Objects] A white box with "ZIMOMO" text is prominent behind him. [Setting] The room has warm, soft indoor lighting. (3) [People] The woman places a yellow straw-like object in her mouth and begins pulling out long, connected chains of red and yellow plastic shapes. The man watches closely and prepares to take them. [Objects] The colorful plastic chain appears from her mouth. [Setting] A static background with home decor and storage shelves. (4) [People] She pulls more blue and yellow sections from her mouth in a rapid magic trick motion. The man takes the accumulating chain and drapes it around his neck. [Objects] The plastic geometric pieces form a large loop. [Setting] A grey exercise ball is visible in the background corner. (5) [People] The man sits covered in several loops of the colorful plastic bands. The woman smiles and gestures toward him with her hands as if presenting the result. [Objects] The man is draped in plastic; his shirt logo is partially visible. [Setting] The final shot remains in the living room environment.
